"''[DROID GRUNTING]|L3-37 frees DD-BD, telling him to free the other droids|audio=L3AndDD-BD.flac|}} '''DD-BD''' was a [[WDD adminmech droid]] that operated within the control hub of [[mining]] operations on [[Kessel]].{{LEGOWeb|url=en-us/themes/star-wars/characters/dd-bd-3a3f83a658124a0b82789965c72c90b9|text=DD-BD}} Before being sold into [[slavery]], DD-BD served on a [[Morseerian]] [[pirate]] [[Starship|ship]]. However, when the ship was impounded by the [[Galactic Empire|Empire]], he was found there and sold at auction to the [[Pyke Syndicate]] for just a fraction of his worth. From there, he was put to work as a slave in the mining operation center on the [[planet]] Kessel. In [[10 BBY]],''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'' dates the events on [[Kessel]] in ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' to nine years after the [[Proclamation of the New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the formation of the Empire to [[19 BBY]]; therefore, the events on Kessel in ''Solo'' must take place in [[10 BBY]]. DD-BD was freed from slavery when his [[restraining bolt]] was removed during a [[Raid on Kessel|slave revolt]] in the [[Mining|mines]] started by the [[droid]] [[L3-37]]. As the first of many droids freed, DD-BD helped spark a rebellion on Kessel. [[Standard decade|Decade]]s later, DD-BD was mentioned in the ''[[Galactic Explorer's Guide]]'', a survival guide written by [[Hondo Ohnaka]] and [[DK-RA-43]].''[[Star Wars: The Galactic Explorer's Guide]]'' {{Droid-stub}} ==Personality and traits== Like other [[Adminmech droid|adminmech]] [[droid]]s, DD-BD was programmed to be driven by efficiency and quotas and never question orders. He possessed a very overeager personality. Being freed by [[L3-37]] awoke a new sense of rebellion and independence within DD-BD, unusual for droids of his class. ==Equipment== DD-BD was encased in a [[Color|white]] [[plastoid]] shell with heavy weighted feet for enhanced stability. He was equipped with a hybrid radar [[eye]] and [[photoreceptor]] and an [[Electro-shock prod|electroprobe]] with variable voltage settings. During his time working on [[Kessel]] he was fitted with a powerful [[restraining bolt]] that was welded to his body and capable of shutting him down or shocking him for failing to obey commands. ==Behind the scenes== DD-BD first appeared in the [[2018]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|''Star Wars'' Anthology]] film ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' and was one of several characters played by ''[[Star Wars]]'' veteran [[Warwick Davis]].{{WebCite|url=https://screenrant.com/warwick-davis-interview-solo-star-wars-story|text=Warwick Davis Interview: Solo: A Star Wars Story|author=Leadbeater, Alex|date=2018-09-25|archivedate=20181006054346}} ==Appearances== *''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' {{1st}} *''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story: Expanded Edition]]'' {{Ab|Solo: A Star Wars Story: Expanded Edition (audiobook)}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=news/solo-a-star-wars-story-products-revealed|text=''Solo: A Star Wars Story'' Products Revealed!}} *''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'' *''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story Ultimate Sticker Collection]]'' *{{Topps|set=2018 Topps Solo: A Star Wars Story|cardname=#31 -
